aliases.alias: Land At Haspielaw Farm, Muttonhole Road, Hamilton ML3 8RX

summary: Proposed data centre campus on land at Haspielaw Farm, Muttonhole Road, south-west of Hamilton, South Lanarkshire, attributed to developer Apatura. The only formal planning record located is an EIA screening opinion request (P/25/0490, received 29 April 2025) describing a data centre campus with ancillary offices/employment floorspace, emergency back-up generators, fuel storage, a battery energy storage system, sub-station and associated works; South Lanarkshire Council determined on 25 June 2025 that EIA is required. No PAN or planning application has been located, no capacity has been disclosed by the developer (campaign group Foxglove uses a 250MW working estimate), and no grid, economic or community details specific to the site were found.
maturity_explanation: EIA screening opinion request P/25/0490 received 29 April 2025 and determined 25 June 2025 (EIA required) is the only formal planning activity located as of 30 July 2026; no PAN, scoping request or application found on the council register (via PlanIt mirror; the council portal itself was unreachable). Early development on thin evidence.

latest_development.headline: South Lanarkshire Council issues screening opinion: EIA required for proposed Haspielaw Farm data centre campus

unknowns: No capacity figure (MW IT load or grid import) has been disclosed by the developer for Haspielaw; the only figure in circulation is Foxglove's 250MW working estimate.

The named applicant on P/25/0490 (which Apatura entity/SPV, or a landowner) is not exposed by the PlanIt mirror and could not be confirmed; attribution to Apatura rests on campaign/journalism sources plus the agent address matching Apatura's York office (1 Bar Lane, York YO1 6JU).

No Proposal of Application Notice (PAN), EIA scoping request or planning application for the site had appeared on the register as of the last PlanIt scrape (July 2025) or via searches to 30 July 2026.
Site area (hectares), red-line boundary, agricultural land classification and confirmed green belt status — green belt status is asserted by APRS but not verified against the council's records.
No grid connection application, offer or substation details specific to Haspielaw were found.
No jobs, investment or other economic claims specific to Haspielaw were found.
No site-specific community or councillor response was found beyond the site's listing on APRS's data centre map.
Relationship (if any) between the data centre proposal and the separate 500MW Cadzow BESS (Advance Grid Solutions, ECU00005042) on adjacent land off Muttonhole Road.
Council screening opinion documents (screening request letter and opinion text) could not be retrieved because the council portal was unreachable from the research environment.
